content_of_post_to_answer: What is one business belief you held when you started that you've completely changed your mind about today?
answer: When I started, I thought the best business decisions came from having the right strategy. Over time, I changed my mind: the hardest part is not choosing a strategy, but recognizing when your assumptions have stopped matching reality. Businesses rarely fail because people lack ideas; they fail because they defend yesterday's beliefs too long. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile, if you want to go deeper. The skill that compounds most is the ability to update your own thinking.
